integrity: The phase law and variational splitting are derived exactly from the published vector field. Numerical Lyapunov values in the source are used only for contextual comparison, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-phase reduction is a statement about bounded complete trajectories and compact recurrence; a generic forward trajectory with nonzero initial relative-phase defect only approaches the zero-defect locus asymptotically. The result does not classify dynamics inside the reduced real Rikitake system.
title: Exact phase locking and Lyapunov splitting in the complex Rikitake dynamo
